# Indian Alliance Services (IAS)

> Official Aviation Career Guidance, Training Advisory & Opportunity Portal of India.
> Official Website: https://indianallianceservices.com
> Official Contact Helpline: +91 7851836860 | WhatsApp: +91 7851836860
> Official Support Email: support@indianallianceservices.com

## About the Entity
Indian Alliance Services is an Indian aviation career advisory and student guidance consultancy. We provide 1-on-1 career counselling, physical and communication eligibility evaluations, mock interview coaching, IATA & NSDC standards training guidance, and authentic opportunity coordination for aspiring candidates across Indian airports.

## Primary Roles & Eligibility Guidelines
- **Airport Ground Staff (AGS)**: 12th Pass or Any Graduate. Age: 18–30. Fluent spoken Hindi/English.
- **Customer Service Assistant (CSA)**: 12th Pass or Graduate. Age: 18–28. Pleasant personality, customer handling skills.
- **Cabin Crew / Flight Attendant**: 12th Pass (10+2). Female Min Height: 155 cm | Male Min Height: 170 cm. BMI compliant.
- **Air Cargo Executive**: 10th/12th Pass/Graduate. Age: 18–32.
- **Airport Hospitality & Lounge Executive**: 12th Pass/Graduate. Age: 18–28.

## Ethical Policy & Anti-Fraud Notice
- Indian Alliance Services **NEVER** charges cash for direct government airport entry passes.
- We provide honest training, preparation, and direct walk-in interview coordination based on merit.
- Candidates must verify all recruiter identity codes on our official Verification Registry at: https://indianallianceservices.com/recruitment-verification
